messages:
alia: thinking out loud — we should add a bulk-edit flow for SLO alert rules in the console. needs: dry-run, per-tenant exceptions, and an estimate of how many alerts will fire after the change.
sam: +1. API question: do we expose a single endpoint like PATCH /slo-rules/bulk or keep a shim that applies multiple PATCHes?
kevin: API-wise bulk endpoint is cleaner but we need idempotency keys and a preview mode. preview should run signal synthesis on historical telemetry, not just rule diffs.
dave: UI side: show three columns in the preview: current alerts/hour, projected alerts/hour, estimated token/cost delta. really helpful for SREs and finance.
maria: don't forget routing policies — if a rule change moves alerts from primary pager -> notify-only we should show affected on-call lists and escalation paths.
alia: agree. also want per-tenant quota guardrails so a misconfigured rule can't spike notification volume for a single customer.
sam: proposal for API shape in a snippet:
```json
POST /api/v1/slo-rules/bulk_preview
{
  "operations": [
    {"op": "patch", "id": "rule-123", "changes": {"threshold_pct": 0.95}},
    {"op": "patch", "id": "rule-456", "changes": {"notify_level": "warn"}}
  ],
  "preview_window_days": 30,
  "idempotency_key": "bulk-20230401-alia"
}
```
kevin: preview service would return a small summary per-op, plus synthesized signal sample: 
```
{"id":"rule-123","current_alerts":12,"projected_alerts":3,"samples":["2024-09-01T12:00Z spike","2024-09-07T03:00Z spike"]}
```
dave: can we also show a single toggle to run the change as a canary for X% of tenants? i.e., rollout UX baked in.
maria: yes but we need routing policy guarantees — if canary causes more latency we auto-fallback to previous routing.
alia: ops question — how do we surface noise confidence? maybe a simple band: low/medium/high and the underlying metric is alert precision over the preview window.
kevin: implementation note: synth runs will be expensive if we do full-query on raw telemetry for every preview. we should sample historical signals and run heuristics for noise estimation. add a cost-estimate field.
sam: +1 to cost-estimate. it should be shown before Apply. small UX: tooltips with the query that was used for the preview.
alia: also need an audit trail: who previewed what, what inputs, and the diff that was applied.
kevin: sounds good. technical snag: current SLO rule model doesn't have per-tenant override pointers, we'd need to extend schema. that affects DB migration.
dave: can we short-circuit by storing per-tenant override map in the config-service (no SQL migration) for MVP?
maria: that's OK for MVP but add a migration ticket to normalize later.
ops-bot: incident suppression rule updated: noise-suppression=v2 will silence alerts when projected_alerts_delta < 5/hour for a tenant.
deploy-bot: rolling deploy queued for the preview-service (canary=10%) — ETA ~ 20m. :rocket:
alia: once canary is up i'll run a couple of previews on a staging tenant and post results.
sam: one more thing — for the bulk API response we should include a human-readable summary string for each op so the console can show it in the change log. e.g., "Lowered threshold for rule-123 (5 -> 3 alerts/hr)"
kevin: agreed. i'll draft the API spec and post a tiny OpenAPI fragment.
dave: thanks — i'll mock the console preview screen after kevin posts the spec.
maria: filing two followups: 1) quota guardrails policy doc, 2) DB migration plan for tenant overrides.
alia: awesome. if no objections i'll open a tiny RFC and link to this thread. :thumbsup:
